model: LightGBM @15m on the Deriv feed, eval session ny, fit session ny, knobs {'train_session': 'ny', 'num_leaves': 255, 'min_child': 400, 'lr': 0.02, 'n_estimators': 800, 'colsample': 0.5, 'reg_lambda': 20.0, 'val_mode': 'block', 'no_early_stop': False, 'train_label': 'sign', 'mag_keep': None, 'include_blackout': False, 'families': None, 'model': 'lgb', 'cat_depth': 8, 'logit_c': 0.05, 'specialist': False, 'comp_gate': 0.33, 'weight': 'none', 'aci_gamma': None, 'aci_target': 0.56, 'meta_keep': None, 'specialist_regime': 'compression', 'nys_gamma_mult': 1.0, 'nys_components': 500, 'null_shift_weeks': 0, 'reflect': False, 'stack_shrink': 0.5, 'mag_model': 'lgb', 'boot_gate': None, 'boot_z': 1.0, 'halflife_days': 60.0, 'multi_horizon': False, 'drift_fe': False, 'monotone': 'none', 'signed_only': False, 'tail_aux': None, 'blend_absret': 'DOWN', 'blend_force_alpha': None, 'rule_gate': None, 'rule_direction': None, 'rule_usd_oriented': False, 'rule_side': None}
data: Deriv 1-second mid ticks only (/mnt/data/deriv), no Dukascopy
blackout_rule: Deriv rejects an FX Rise/Fall purchase whose expiry lands in 16:50-18:00 New York (daily close/rollover; 15m: last accepted start 16:34:40 NY, first rejected 16:35:10 NY - docs/DERIV_DEMO_EXECUTOR.md (g)); decisions with start in [16:50 - H, 18:00) NY are untradeable and excluded from training, validation and test (starts inside the rollover itself, 17:45-18:00 for 15m, are excluded conservatively)
CERT_RULE: side CERTIFIED iff VALID AND p10>=0.541 AND frac_clear_BE>=0.80 (unrounded path win rates; paths with >= 25 trades)

falsifier.KILL_if: at the operating coverage 0.1: each side p10<0.541 OR frac_clear_BE<0.80
falsifier.INVALID_if: in-session moved up-rate outside [0.47,0.53], or any path moved up-rate outside [0.45,0.55]; an INVALID run certifies nothing in any field

blend_absret.models: the --model lgb recipe, seed 0, unweighted and |return| / mean weighted, same fit rows
blend_absret.selection: max over alpha of the smaller first-come win rate on SIDE in the two chronological halves of the gated validation rows at the operating coverage; ties to smaller alpha
